evidence.text: We constructed the prediction set MAaFAbCs1−a−bPbxSn1−xBrmI1−m (a, b, x, m = 0, 0.01, 0.02, 0.03...1), In total, there are about 5.2 × 107 compounds in the search space as the prediction set.

In order to observe the band gap distribution of potential compositions, we constructed a new prediction set with the component MAaFAbCs1−a−bPbxSn1−xBrmClnI1−m−n (a, b, x, m, n = 0, 0.02, 0.04, 0.06...1) with 8.8 × 107 groups.

material_scope: ABX3 structure (A = Cs, FA, or MA; B = Pb or Sn; X = Br, Cl, or I)

evidence.text: Finally, we randomly selected three groups among the remaining compositions for the experimental synthesis. As can be seen in Figure 4a, we selected compositions in the original data set with sparse distribution of data points and located in three different band gap ranges, which can better demonstrate the predictive power of the model.

Three compositions were experimentally synthesized, and the XRD results are presented in Figure 4b, indicating that all three compositions possess pure perovskite structures. The band gap values, measured by UV−vis spectra, are shown in Figure 4c.
